choices: Draws the text 'Hello' with its top-left corner at (50,100)
Draws the text 'Hello' with its baseline at y=100 and leftmost character at x=50
Draws a rectangle containing the text 'Hello' at (50,100)
Draws the text 'Hello' centered at the point (50,100)
explanation: drawString uses the font baseline (not top-left) for the y coordinate. The baseline is the line letters 'sit on' — descenders like g and y go below it. To position by top-left, use FontMetrics to measure ascent: y = topY + fm.getAscent().
